ItemID: NA; Title: Bolt Dropper 1/2" Stainless Flat Finish Washer, 1-1/4" Outside Diameter - 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel, Highly Corrosion-Resistant and Rustproof - Convenient for Any Project Needs (50 Pack); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for washers in this specific size.
ItemID: NA; Title: 3" Swivel Caster Wheels with Safety Dual Locking and Polyurethane Foam No Noise Wheels, Heavy Duty - 250 Lbs Per Caster (Pack of 4); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My handtruck purchase does not mean I currently need wheels for a separate project.
ItemID: NA; Title: No. 6 x 1/2" Stainless Truss Head Phillips Wood Screw, (100 pc), 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel Sheet Metal Screws, Type A Point, Plain Finish by Bolt Dropper; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need a project requiring this screw size before buying a pack.
ItemID: NA; Title: SELTERM 25pcs 4 AWG 3/8" Stud Battery Lugs, Ring Terminals, Heavy Duty Copper Wire Lugs, Battery Cable Ends, 4 Guage Ring Terminal Connectors, UL Bare Copper Eyelets Electrical Battery Cable Lugs; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My previous spade connectors were for smaller wires; I have no clear need for heavy battery cable lugs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Super Lube 56204 O-Ring Silicone Lubricant, Clear; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Hose clamps alone do not give me a reason to buy specialized O-ring lubricant.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gorilla Super Glue Gel, 20 Gram, Clear, (Pack of 10); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Adhesives interest me, but ten tubes are more than I would choose without a specific repair need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Kuject 120PCS Solder Seal Wire Connectors, Self-Solder Heat Shrink Butt Connector Solder Sleeve Waterproof Insulated Electrical Butt Splice Wire Terminals for Marine Automotive Boat Truck Wire Joint; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try these for sealed wire repairs, which fits my previous interest in electrical connectors.
ItemID: NA; Title: 560PCS Heat Shrink Tubing 2:1, Eventronic Electrical Wire Cable Wrap Assortment Electric Insulation Heat Shrink Tube Kit with Box(5 colors/12 Sizes); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Assorted tubing would complement my crimp connectors by insulating wire repairs; I would choose this kit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Loctite Epoxy Five Minute Instant Mix, Two 0.47-Fluid Ounce Syringes (1715208); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My tape and vinyl cement purchases suggest repair needs, but I do not currently have a clear use for epoxy.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ginsco 580 pcs 2:1 Heat Shrink Tubing Kit 6 Colors 11 Sizes Assorted Sleeving Tube Wrap Cable Wire Kit for DIY; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This fits my wiring interests, but I would skip it after choosing the other heat shrink assortment.
